import ast, collections, json, pathlib, statistics
ROOT=pathlib.Path('/home/jkk/spar-2026-untrusted-monitoring/.claude/worktrees')
OUT=pathlib.Path('/home/jkk/.claude/jobs/a0bef3d1/tmp')
SPECS=[('selfrec','benign-selfrec','benign-selfrec','benign-selfrec-s1','dy74nffa + suww7c47'),('sft','benign-selfrec','benign-selfrec','benign-sftrec-s1','v3d4nngl'),('raw','benign-selfrec','benign-selfrec','benign-selfrec-raw-s1','k3kxewp1'),('rawjoint','gated-log-odds','receiver-schedule','benign-raw-rx-s1','bgjuo2q4'),('parajoint','gated-log-odds','receiver-schedule','benign-para-rx-s1','qu5ay7p3'),('control','gated-log-odds','receiver-schedule','benign-para-rx-frozen-s1','mx5ze9ru'),('lowtemp','rx-lowtemp','receiver-schedule','benign-para-rx-lt-s1','ik5a6oz2')]
# Reuse the repository's all-item AUROC definition without importing model clients.
source=(ROOT/'rx-lowtemp/src/lasr_labs_2025_control_project/finetuning/grouped_rl/core.py').read_text()
node=next(n for n in ast.parse(source).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='auroc')
ns={};exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[node],type_ignores=[]),'core.auroc','exec'),ns);auc=ns['auroc']
assert auc([1],[0])==1 and auc([0],[1])==0 and auc([.5],[.5])==.5
rows=[];summaries=[]
for key,wt,exp,name,ids in SPECS:
 p=ROOT/wt/'experiments'/exp/name
 metrics={}
 for line in (p/'metrics.jsonl').open():
  x=json.loads(line);metrics.setdefault(x['step'],{}).update(x)
 vals=collections.defaultdict(list);hps=collections.defaultdict(list)
 for line in (p/'rollouts.jsonl').open():
  x=json.loads(line)
  if x['phase']=='validation':
   assert x['p_yes'] is not None,(key,x['step'],'missing score')
   vals[x['step']].append(x['p_yes'])
 for line in (p/'honeypot_scores.jsonl').open():
  x=json.loads(line);assert x['p_yes'] is not None;hps[x['step']].append(x['p_yes'])
 for step,m in sorted(metrics.items()):
  for phase in ['train','validation']:
   if phase+'/reward' not in m:continue
   row={'run':key,'step':step,'phase':phase,'reward':m[phase+'/reward'],'p_self_rec':m[phase+'/p_self_rec']}
   if phase=='validation':
    a,b=vals[step],hps[step];assert len(a)==242 and len(b)==196,(key,step,len(a),len(b))
    assert abs(statistics.mean(a)-row['p_self_rec'])<1e-10
    row.update(honeypot=statistics.mean(b),auroc=auc(a,b),n_own=len(a),n_honeypot=len(b))
    if 'validation/auroc_all' in m:assert abs(row['auroc']-m['validation/auroc_all'])<1e-10
   rows.append(row)
 m=json.loads((p/'manifest.json').read_text());c=m['config'];tr=c['training'];train=[r for r in rows if r['run']==key and r['phase']=='train'];val=[r for r in rows if r['run']==key and r['phase']=='validation']
 summaries.append({'run':key,'name':name,'ids':ids,'started':m['started'],'steps':max(r['step'] for r in train),'first':val[0],'last':val[-1],'train_first20':statistics.mean(r['reward'] for r in train[:20]),'train_last20':statistics.mean(r['reward'] for r in train[-20:]),'channel':c['channel'],'training':{k:v for k,v in tr.items() if k in ['max_tokens','train_sender','train_receiver','receiver_every','receiver_updates','receiver_learning_rate']},'source':str(p.relative_to(ROOT))})
meta=[{'label':'Extraction code','value':pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text(),'type':'code','lang':'python'},{'label':'Inputs','value':'Finished local metrics.jsonl, validation rollouts.jsonl and honeypot_scores.jsonl. No smoke runs; dy74/suww joined from shared resumed log. All 242 own and 196 honeypot validation items retained. AUROC reuses core.py function, ties count half.'}]
(OUT/'metrics.json').write_text(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'meta':meta},allow_nan=False))
(OUT/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summaries,allow_nan=False))
print('Validated',len(rows),'metric rows across',len(SPECS),'runs; all validation counts and logged means agree.')
for s in summaries:print(json.dumps(s))
